methodology.protocol: Seven feature variants use identical BTC/ETH rows, calendar folds, model hyperparameters, and past-only threshold selection. All source joins are causal and 2026-H1 remains untouched until final evaluation.

methodology.folds: Five fixed calendar half-years from 2024-H1 through 2026-H1
methodology.nested_policy: For each fold, the preceding 180 days are split chronologically into reliability training, probability calibration, and policy selection. Test labels never select the threshold.
